name: University of Guelph
summary: Founded 1964 on veterinary and agricultural roots; 75+ majors in eight colleges on a campus an hour from Toronto.

ib.text: IB Diploma with 3 HL and 3 SL and a minimum score of 28 (many programs need more); program prerequisites must be taken in the final IB year; TOK and EE bonus marks are considered.

apply.via: Direct application via OUAC, or the Common App

programmes.name: Bio-Medical Science
programmes.about: A broad foundation in human and animal health, from physiology and anatomy to immunology and pathology, with hands-on dissection courses. It meets the entry requirements of Ontario medical and veterinary schools.
programmes.ib: English, Maths (AA, or AI HL) and two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics, all taken in the final IB year, with a total of at least 28.

needs.note: Two of the three are required

programmes.selectionNote: Admission rests on your predicted IB score, at least 28, with TOK and EE bonus marks considered; meeting the minimum does not guarantee an offer.

flagshipSource.title: Bio-Medical Science: hands-on human and animal anatomy, including human donor dissection

programmes.name: Honours Agriculture
programmes.about: A core of agriculture and food science combined with courses in business, animals, plants and the environment, chosen with a faculty advisor. The co-op route takes five years with four paid work terms.
programmes.ib: English, Maths (AA, or AI HL) and two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics, all taken in the final IB year, with a total of at least 28.

needs.note: Two of the three are required

programmes.selectionNote: Admission rests on your predicted IB score, at least 28, with TOK and EE bonus marks considered; meeting the minimum does not guarantee an offer.

flagshipSource.title: Rankings page: QS subject results for agriculture and hospitality

programmes.name: Hospitality and Tourism Management
programmes.about: A business degree for hotels, events, resorts, restaurants and tourism, with a food lab, case competitions and an optional 12-month co-op. In second year you pick an emphasis such as marketing or beverage management.
programmes.ib: English and Maths (AA, or AI HL) taken in the final IB year, with a total of at least 28.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission rests on your predicted IB score, at least 28, with TOK and EE bonus marks considered; meeting the minimum does not guarantee an offer.

faculties.name: College of Arts
faculties.line: BA majors need English; Economics adds Maths (AA, or AI HL). Minimum IB score of 28.

faculties.name: College of Biological Science
faculties.line: English, Maths (AA, or AI HL) and two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics for the Biological Sciences majors.

faculties.name: Gordon S. Lang School of Business and Economics
faculties.line: Commerce majors need English and Maths (AA, or AI HL); most majors have a co-op option.

faculties.name: College of Computational, Mathematical and Physical Sciences
faculties.line: Computing and Mathematics need English and calculus-level Maths; Physical Sciences add two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics.

faculties.name: College of Engineering
faculties.line: English, calculus-level Maths, Chemistry and Physics for every engineering major.

faculties.name: College of Social and Applied Human Sciences
faculties.line: Applied Human Nutrition needs English, Maths, Biology and Chemistry; Child Studies and Family Studies need English and Maths.

faculties.name: Ontario Agricultural College
faculties.line: Agriculture and Environmental Sciences: English, Maths (AA, or AI HL) and two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics.

notes: EU students are not Canadian citizens, so they apply directly or through the Common App; OUAC is for Canadian citizens and permanent residents.
Maths AI SL is not accepted for any program that needs Advanced Math or calculus; take Maths AA (SL or HL) or Maths AI HL.
The university guarantees that tuition rises by no more than 5% a year after you start.
